definitions.explanation: The mental and emotional aspects of a person, as opposed to the physical.
The underlying principles or attitude of something.

⟦{精神|せいしん}{的|てき}→精神的：05851_seishinteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧で⟦いたい→いる：00495_iru⟧。

notes:
{精神|せいしん} refers to the mind, spirit, or underlying principles.
